<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Crypto Exchange Global | P2P USDT and crypto trading</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@500;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#EEF3F6;--surface:#FFFFFF;--ink:#0C2233;--muted:#4D6272;--line:#CFDAE2;--accent:#0B6B8A;--accent-ink:#FFFFFF;--hi:#E3A82B;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0B1A26;--surface:#12283A;--ink:#E8F0F5;--muted:#9DB3C2;--line:#24405A;--accent:#4FB6D6;--accent-ink:#06202D;--hi:#E8B94A}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0B1A26;--surface:#12283A;--ink:#E8F0F5;--muted:#9DB3C2;--line:#24405A;--accent:#4FB6D6;--accent-ink:#06202D;--hi:#E8B94A}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 17px/1.6 "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.1;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--hi);outline-offset:2px}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:18px 0}
.brand{font:700 20px "Bricolage Grotesque",Arial,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.brand i{display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--hi);margin-right:8px}
nav a{margin-left:18px;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;padding:36px 0 64px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(36px,6vw,64px);font-weight:700}
.hero p.lead{font-size:19px;color:var(--muted);max-width:46ch;margin:20px 0 0}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:24px;padding:0;list-style:none}
.tags li{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:99px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.quote{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:24px}
.quote h2{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:4px}
.quote .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin:0 0 16px}
.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}
.seg button{padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-radius:10px;font:500 15px inherit;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
label{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;margin:12px 0 4px}
input,select{width:100%;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:inherit}
.btn{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:18px;padding:13px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font:700 16px "Bricolage Grotesque",Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.btn.alt{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:8px;font-weight:500}
#out{display:none;margin-top:16px;padding:12px;border-left:4px solid var(--hi);background:var(--bg);font-size:14px;white-space:pre-wrap;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0}
#status{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);min-height:20px;margin:8px 0 0}
section{padding:56px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
section h2{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,40px);margin-bottom:12px}
section p.intro{color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch;margin:0 0 32px}
ol.steps{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;counter-reset:s}
ol.steps li{counter-increment:s;border-top:3px solid var(--accent);padding-top:14px}
ol.steps li::before{content:"Step " counter(s);display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:4px}
ol.steps h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:6px}
ol.steps p{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.assets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:16px}
.asset{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px}
.asset b{font:700 26px "Bricolage Grotesque",Arial,sans-serif;display:block}
.asset span{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.safe{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:28px}
.safe h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:6px}
.safe p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:32px 0 40px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
footer p{max-width:80ch;margin:0 0 10px}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
nav{display:flex;align-items:center}
.tt{margin-left:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 12px;font:500 14px inherit;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.glance{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);margin-bottom:56px}
.glance div{padding:18px 20px;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
.glance div:last-child{border-right:0}
.glance b{display:block;font:700 18px 'Bricolage Grotesque',Arial,sans-serif}
.glance span{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px}
.tabs button{padding:9px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-radius:99px;font:500 15px inherit;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.tabs button[aria-pressed='true']{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
.prep{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:32px;align-items:start}
.checks{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px}
.checks li{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.checks li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.checks label{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin:0;padding:14px 18px;font-weight:400;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}
.checks input{width:20px;height:20px;margin-top:3px;flex:none;accent-color:var(--accent)}
.prog{font:700 22px 'Bricolage Grotesque',Arial,sans-serif;margin:0 0 6px}
.bar{height:8px;background:var(--line);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin:10px 0 14px}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--hi);transition:width .25s}
.why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px}
.why div{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:22px}
.why h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:6px}
.why p{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 0}
summary{cursor:pointer;font:700 19px 'Bricolage Grotesque',Arial,sans-serif;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
summary::after{content:'+';font-size:24px;line-height:1;color:var(--accent)}
details[open] summary::after{content:'\2212'}
details p{margin:10px 0 0;color:var(--muted);max-width:68ch}
.cta{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-radius:20px;padding:44px 28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px}
.cta h2{font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,36px);margin:0}
.cta p{margin:6px 0 0;opacity:.9}
.cta .row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cta a{background:var(--accent-ink);color:var(--accent);padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:28px;margin-bottom:24px}
.cols h4{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--ink);font:700 15px 'Bricolage Grotesque',Arial,sans-serif}
.cols a{display:block;text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:6px}
.cols a:hover{color:var(--ink)}

:root{--up:#1E9E6A;--down:#D6453B}
.logo{display:block;height:46px;width:auto;border-radius:10px;background:#FDF7EB}
.mk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:36px;align-items:center}
.cc{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:18px}
.ch{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
.ch .tabs{margin:0}
.ch .tabs button{padding:6px 14px;font-size:14px}
#chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.cap{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:8px 2px 0}
.cd{opacity:0;animation:cin .35s ease forwards}
@keyframes cin{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.ma{stroke-dasharray:1;stroke-dashoffset:1;animation:dr 1.6s .4s ease forwards}
@keyframes dr{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cd{animation:none;opacity:1}.ma{animation:none;stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@media (max-width:820px){.mk{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

#sp{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:0;background:var(--hi);z-index:60}
.hero{position:relative}
#net{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}
.hero>div{position:relative;z-index:1}
.coin{position:absolute;width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 26px 'Bricolage Grotesque',Arial,sans-serif;color:#fff;animation:spin 5s linear infinite,bob 4s ease-in-out infinite;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.35);pointer-events:none}
.c1{background:#E3A82B;left:47%;top:4%}.c2{background:#26A17B;left:-8px;bottom:4%;animation-delay:-2s}.c3{background:#0B6B8A;right:2%;top:-10px;animation-delay:-3s}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotateY(360deg)}}
@keyframes bob{50%{margin-top:-12px}}
.quote{animation:glow 3.5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes glow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(227,168,43,0)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(227,168,43,.2)}}
.mq{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface);margin-bottom:56px}
.mq div{display:flex;gap:42px;width:max-content;padding:14px 20px;animation:mq 30s linear infinite;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.mq b{color:var(--ink)}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .7s,transform .7s}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.sg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px}
.sk,.asset,.why>div{transition:transform .15s;will-change:transform}
.sk{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px}
.sk b{font:700 18px 'Bricolage Grotesque',Arial,sans-serif}
.sk svg{width:100%;display:block;margin-top:6px}
.sl{stroke-dasharray:1;stroke-dashoffset:1;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.4s}
.in .sl{stroke-dashoffset:0}
.vzg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
.vz{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px}
.vz h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:10px}
.vz svg{width:100%;display:block}
.dp{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom;transform:scaleY(0);transition:transform 1.1s}
.in .dp{transform:none}
.ob .r{display:flex;margin:4px 0}
.ob i{display:block;height:14px;width:50%;opacity:.6;border-radius:3px;transition:width .9s}
.ob .a i{background:var(--down)}.ob .b i{background:var(--up)}
.spr{text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0}
.vb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:14px 0;font-size:15px}
.vb div{background:var(--line);border-radius:99px;height:12px;overflow:hidden}
.vb i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;background:var(--accent);transition:width 1.3s}
.in .vb i{width:var(--w)}
.flowc{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:10px}
.flowc svg{width:100%;display:block}
.ck circle,.ck path{stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:100;transition:stroke-dashoffset .9s .2s}
.in .ck circle,.in .ck path{stroke-dashoffset:0}
.safe .ck{margin-bottom:8px}
ol.steps li{position:relative;border-top-color:var(--line)}
ol.steps li::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:-3px;height:3px;width:0;background:var(--accent);transition:width .9s}
ol.steps.in li::after{width:100%}
ol.steps li:nth-child(2)::after{transition-delay:.3s}ol.steps li:nth-child(3)::after{transition-delay:.6s}ol.steps li:nth-child(4)::after{transition-delay:.9s}
#gauge{display:block;margin:0 0 4px}
#gf{transition:stroke-dashoffset .5s}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.coin,.mq div,.quote{animation:none}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media (max-width:900px){.vzg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.c1{display:none}}

#sp{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#26A17B,#627EEA,#F7931A,#D6453B)}
.hero>.aur{position:absolute;inset:-10px;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;border-radius:28px}
.aur i{position:absolute;width:340px;height:340px;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(70px);opacity:.34;animation:drift 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.aur i:nth-child(1){background:#26A17B;left:-60px;top:-80px}
.aur i:nth-child(2){background:#627EEA;right:-40px;top:0;animation-delay:-5s}
.aur i:nth-child(3){background:#F7931A;left:35%;bottom:-140px;animation-delay:-9s}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translate(50px,36px) scale(1.15)}}
.tags li::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:8px;background:var(--d,#26A17B)}
.tags li:nth-child(2)::before{--d:#F7931A}.tags li:nth-child(3)::before{--d:#627EEA}.tags li:nth-child(4)::before{--d:#8B5CF6}
.asset::before{content:attr(data-s);display:block;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--cc);color:#fff;text-align:center;line-height:40px;font:700 19px/40px 'Bricolage Grotesque',Arial,sans-serif}
.asset{border-top:5px solid var(--cc)}
.asset:nth-child(1){--cc:#26A17B}.asset:nth-child(2){--cc:#F7931A}.asset:nth-child(3){--cc:#627EEA}.asset:nth-child(4){--cc:#8B5CF6}
ol.steps li:nth-child(1)::after{background:#26A17B}ol.steps li:nth-child(2)::after{background:#627EEA}ol.steps li:nth-child(3)::after{background:#F7931A}ol.steps li:nth-child(4)::after{background:#D6453B}
.cta{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#0B6B8A,#627EEA,#8B5CF6,#26A17B);background-size:300% 300%;animation:gx 10s ease infinite;color:#fff}
.cta a{background:#fff;color:#0B3A52}
@keyframes gx{50%{background-position:100% 50%}}
#send{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#send::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-60%;width:40%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.45),transparent);transform:skewX(-20deg);animation:sh 3.2s infinite}
@keyframes sh{to{left:130%}}
.fab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:40;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#26A17B,#627EEA);color:#fff;font:700 16px 'Bricolage Grotesque',Arial,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;animation:pulse 2.4s infinite;transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s}
.fab.hide{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);pointer-events:none}
@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(98,126,234,.55)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(98,126,234,0)}}
.moodg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.hmg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}
.ht{border-radius:10px;padding:18px 4px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;transition:background 1.2s}
.bub g{animation:fl 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes fl{to{transform:translateY(-14px)}}
.mixg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:32px;align-items:center}
#dn{width:100%;max-width:300px;margin:auto;display:block}
#dn circle{transition:stroke-dasharray .5s,stroke-dashoffset .5s}
.mr{margin:0 0 16px}
.mr label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 0 4px;font-weight:700}
.mr input{padding:0;accent-color:var(--c)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.aur i,.fab,#send::after,.bub g,.cta{animation:none}}
@media (max-width:820px){.moodg,.mixg{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:820px){.glance{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.glance div:nth-child(2){border-right:0}.glance div:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.prep{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media (max-width:820px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-top:12px}ol.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}nav a:not(.keep){display:none}}
@media (max-width:480px){ol.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="sp"></div>
<div class="wrap">
<header>
  <a class="brand" href="#top"><img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Crypto Exchange Global"></a>
  <nav><a href="#how">How it works</a><a href="#assets">Assets</a><a href="#prepare">Prepare</a><a href="#safety">Safety</a><a href="#faq">FAQ</a><a class="keep" href="#quote">Get a quote</a><button class="tt" id="tt" type="button" aria-label="Switch light or dark theme">Theme</button></nav>
</header>

<main id="top">
<div class="hero">
  <div class="aur" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><canvas id="net" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="coin c1" aria-hidden="true">B</span><span class="coin c2" aria-hidden="true">&#8366;</span><span class="coin c3" aria-hidden="true">E</span>
  <div>
    <h1>Trade USDT and crypto directly with a real person.</h1>
    <p class="lead">Crypto Exchange Global handles peer-to-peer buying and selling of USDT and other digital assets. Tell us what you want to trade and we reply with terms before anything moves.</p>
    <ul class="tags"><li>USDT</li><li>Bitcoin</li><li>Ethereum</li><li>Other assets on request</li></ul>
  </div>

  <div class="quote" id="quote">
    <h2>Request a quote</h2>
    <p class="sub">No prices are shown here. We confirm the rate with you directly.</p>
    <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Trade direction">
      <button type="button" id="dBuy" aria-pressed="true">I want to buy</button>
      <button type="button" id="dSell" aria-pressed="false">I want to sell</button>
    </div>
    <label for="asset">Asset</label>
    <select id="asset"><option>USDT</option><option>Bitcoin (BTC)</option><option>Ethereum (ETH)</option><option>Other</option></select>
    <label for="amt">Amount</label>
    <input id="amt" type="text" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="e.g. 5,000">
    <label for="pay">Payment method</label>
    <select id="pay"><option>Bank transfer</option><option>Wire</option><option>Cash deposit</option><option>Other</option></select>
    <label for="name">Your name</label>
    <input id="name" type="text" autocomplete="name">
    <button class="btn" id="send" type="button">Send request</button>
    <button class="btn alt" id="copy" type="button">Copy request text</button>
    <div id="out" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <p id="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="glance">
  <div><b>Peer to peer</b><span>Deal directly with us</span></div>
  <div><b>USDT focus</b><span>Plus other major assets</span></div>
  <div><b>Verified trades</b><span>Checks before funds move</span></div>
  <div><b>Terms in writing</b><span>Agreed before you pay</span></div>
</div>

<div class="mq" aria-label="Assets, networks and payment methods to ask about"><div id="mqi"><span>Ask us about:</span><span><b>USDT</b></span><span><b>BTC</b></span><span><b>ETH</b></span><span>TRC20 network</span><span>ERC20 network</span><span>BEP20 network</span><span>Bank transfer</span><span>Wire transfer</span></div></div>

<section id="markets">
  <div class="mk">
    <div>
      <h2>Know the market you are trading</h2>
      <p class="intro" style="margin-bottom:0">USDT is built to stay close to one dollar, while assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum swing widely. Switch assets and ranges to see the difference in shape.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cc">
      <div class="ch">
        <div class="tabs" id="asetTabs" role="group" aria-label="Asset"><button type="button" data-a="USDT" aria-pressed="true">USDT</button><button type="button" data-a="BTC" aria-pressed="false">BTC</button><button type="button" data-a="ETH" aria-pressed="false">ETH</button></div>
        <div class="tabs" id="rngTabs" role="group" aria-label="Range"><button type="button" data-r="1D" aria-pressed="false">1D</button><button type="button" data-r="1W" aria-pressed="true">1W</button><button type="button" data-r="1M" aria-pressed="false">1M</button></div>
      </div>

    <li><h3>Verify</h3><p>We check identity and payment details before funds move.</p></li>

<section id="why">

    <div><h3>Flexible payment methods</h3><p>Bank transfer, wire and other methods, agreed per trade.</p></div>
    <div><h3>Network confirmed up front</h3><p>We confirm the blockchain network before you send, so funds go to the right place.</p></div>
    <div><h3>Built by compliance people</h3><p>Identity and source-of-funds checks are part of how we work.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="safety">

    <div><h3>Terms in writing</h3><p>Rate, fees and timing are confirmed before you send anything.</p></div>
    <div><h3>Source of funds</h3><p>We may ask where funds come from and decline trades we cannot verify.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="faq">
  <h2>Common questions</h2>
  <p class="intro">Short answers before you get in touch.</p>
  <details><summary>Where can I see your rates?</summary><p>We do not post fixed rates because they move with the market and with trade size. Send a request and we confirm the rate with you before you pay.</p></details>
  <details><summary>Which networks do you support for USDT?</summary><p>We confirm the network, such as TRC20 or ERC20, when we agree terms. Always check it with us before you send funds.</p></details>
  <details><summary>Do I need to verify my identity?</summary><p>Yes. We check identity before the first trade and may ask about the source of funds.</p></details>
  <details><summary>Is there a minimum or maximum trade size?</summary><p>Limits depend on the asset and payment method. We confirm them in your quote.</p></details>
  <details><summary>How long does a trade take?</summary><p>It depends on the payment method and the blockchain network. We tell you the expected timing when we agree terms.</p></details>
  <details><summary>What are the risks?</summary><p>Crypto prices are volatile and blockchain transfers cannot be reversed. Only trade amounts you can afford, and double-check every wallet address.</p></details>
</section>

<script>

}
function show(t){ var o = $("out"); o.style.display = "block"; o.textContent = t; }

  catch(e){ msg("Select the text above and copy it."); }
}
$("copy").onclick = function(){ var t = build(); show(t); copyText(t); };

var LISTS = {
  buy: ["Government-issued photo ID", "Your wallet address and the network it uses", "The amount you want to buy", "Payment method in your own name"],
  sell: ["Government-issued photo ID", "The wallet that will send the crypto", "The amount you want to sell", "Bank account in your own name to receive payment"]
};
var tab = "buy";
function renderChecks(){
  var ul = $("checks"); ul.innerHTML = "";

    var li = document.createElement("li");
    var lb = document.createElement("label");
    var cb = document.createElement("input"); cb.type = "checkbox"; cb.onchange = updateProg;
    var sp = document.createElement("span"); sp.textContent = txt;
    lb.appendChild(cb); lb.appendChild(sp); li.appendChild(lb); ul.appendChild(li);
  });
  $("tB").setAttribute("aria-pressed", tab==="buy"); $("tS").setAttribute("aria-pressed", tab==="sell");
  updateProg();
}
function updateProg(){
  var all = $("checks").querySelectorAll("input"), n = 0;
  all.forEach(function(c){ if (c.checked) n++; });
  $("prog").textContent = n + " of " + all.length + " ready";
  $("barfill").style.width = (all.length ? n/all.length*100 : 0) + "%";
}
$("tB").onclick = function(){ tab = "buy"; renderChecks(); };
$("tS").onclick = function(){ tab = "sell"; renderChecks(); };
renderChecks();

$("tt").onclick = function(){

  r.setAttribute("data-theme", dark ? "light" : "dark");
};

if (CONTACT.whatsapp) { var w = $("waLink"); w.hidden = false; w.href = "https://wa.me/" + CONTACT.whatsapp; w.target = "_blank"; }

};
var VOL={USDT:0.0006,BTC:0.022,ETH:0.028}, DRIFT={USDT:0,BTC:0.002,ETH:-0.001}, RS={"1D":1,"1W":2,"1M":3}, AS={USDT:11,BTC:23,ETH:37};
var ca="USDT", cr="1W";
function rng(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;var t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
function mk(tag,at){var e=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",tag);for(var k in at)e.setAttribute(k,at[k]);return e}
function drawChart(){
  var svg=$("chart"); svg.innerHTML="";
  var r=rng(AS[ca]*100+RS[cr]), N=48, v=VOL[ca]*(cr==="1D"?0.7:cr==="1M"?1.4:1), p=1, d=[];
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++){var o=p,c=o*(1+DRIFT[ca]+(r()-.5)*2*v),hi=Math.max(o,c)*(1+r()*v*.6),lo=Math.min(o,c)*(1-r()*v*.6);d.push({o:o,c:c,h:hi,l:lo,vol:.25+r()*.75});p=c;}
  var R=VOL[ca]*10, top=10, ch=270, vt=300, vh=64, W=900, step=W/N, bw=step*.55;

  for(var g=0;g<=4;g++){var gy=top+g*ch/4;svg.appendChild(mk("line",{x1:0,x2:W,y1:gy,y2:gy,stroke:"var(--line)","stroke-width":1}))}
  var pts=[],sum=0;
  d.forEach(function(k,i){
    var x=i*step+step/2, up=k.c>=k.o, col=up?"var(--up)":"var(--down)";
    var g=mk("g",{"class":"cd",style:"animation-delay:"+(i*22)+"ms"});
    g.appendChild(mk("line",{x1:x,x2:x,y1:y(k.h),y2:y(k.l),stroke:col,"stroke-width":2}));
    g.appendChild(mk("rect",{x:x-bw/2,width:bw,y:Math.min(y(k.o),y(k.c)),height:Math.max(2,Math.abs(y(k.o)-y(k.c))),fill:col,rx:1.5}));
    g.appendChild(mk("rect",{x:x-bw/2,width:bw,y:vt+vh-k.vol*vh,height:k.vol*vh,fill:col,opacity:.35,rx:1.5}));
    svg.appendChild(g);
    sum+=k.c; if(i>=7){sum-=(i>7?d[i-8].c:0)} 
  });
  for(var j=0;j<N;j++){var a=Math.max(0,j-7),s2=0;for(var m=a;m<=j;m++)s2+=d[m].c;pts.push((j*step+step/2)+","+y(s2/(j-a+1)))}
  svg.appendChild(mk("polyline",{points:pts.join(" "),fill:"none",stroke:"var(--hi)","stroke-width":3,"stroke-linejoin":"round",pathLength:1,"class":"ma"}));
}

    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){p*=1+(r()-.5)*2*v;if(i===0)first=p;last=p;var y=26-Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(p-1)/half))*22;pts.push((i*140/(n-1)).toFixed(1)+","+y.toFixed(1))}
    var col=last>=first?"var(--up)":"var(--down)",d=document.createElement("div");d.className="sk";

})();
(function(){

    for(var i=1;i<=n;i++){var x=mid+dir*i*(mid-4)/n;d+=" L"+x+","+(H-cum);cum=Math.min(cum+6+r()*14,H-14);d+=" L"+x+","+(H-cum)}

  var ob=$("ob");
  function row(c){var d=document.createElement("div");d.className="r "+c;d.appendChild(document.createElement("i"));ob.appendChild(d)}
  for(var i=0;i<6;i++)row("a");
  var sp=document.createElement("div");sp.className="spr";sp.textContent="Spread";ob.appendChild(sp);
  for(i=0;i<6;i++)row("b");

})();
(function(){
  var cv=$("globe"),x=cv.getContext("2d"),S=360,dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1),rot=0,vis=false,R=150,C=180,r=rng(9),dots=[];
  cv.width=cv.height=S*dpr;x.scale(dpr,dpr);
  for(var i=0;i<14;i++)dots.push([-50+r()*110,-180+r()*360]);

  new IntersectionObserver(function(e){vis=e[0].isIntersecting}).observe(cv);
  function frame(t){
    if(vis){var cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement),ac=cs.getPropertyValue("--accent").trim(),hi=cs.getPropertyValue("--hi").trim();
      x.clearRect(0,0,S,S);x.lineWidth=1;x.strokeStyle=ac;x.globalAlpha=.55;
      x.beginPath();x.arc(C,C,R,0,7);x.stroke();
      for(var la=-60;la<=60;la+=30)line(function(o){return P(la,o)},-180,180);
      for(var lo=0;lo<360;lo+=30)line(function(a){return P(a,lo)},-90,90);
      x.globalAlpha=1;var pr=dots.map(function(d){return P(d[0],d[1])});
      x.strokeStyle=hi;x.globalAlpha=.5;
      for(var k=0;k<pr.length-1;k+=2){if(pr[k][2]>0&&pr[k+1][2]>0){x.beginPath();x.moveTo(C+R*pr[k][0],C-R*pr[k][1]);x.quadraticCurveTo(C+R*(pr[k][0]+pr[k+1][0])*.7,C-R*(pr[k][1]+pr[k+1][1])*.7,C+R*pr[k+1][0],C-R*pr[k+1][1]);x.stroke()}}
      x.globalAlpha=1;x.fillStyle=hi;
      pr.forEach(function(q,i){if(q[2]>0){var pu=(Math.sin(t/400+i)+1)/2;x.beginPath();x.arc(C+R*q[0],C-R*q[1],3+pu*2,0,7);x.fill()}});
      if(!RM)rot+=.004}
    requestAnimationFrame(frame)
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
(function(){
  var cv=$("net"),h=cv.parentNode,x=cv.getContext("2d"),W,H,ps=[],r=rng(3);
  function sz(){W=cv.width=h.offsetWidth;H=cv.height=h.offsetHeight}
  sz();window.addEventListener("resize",sz);
  for(var i=0;i<38;i++)ps.push({x:r()*W,y:r()*H,vx:(r()-.5)*.5,vy:(r()-.5)*.5});
  function f(){
    x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);var ac=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--accent").trim();x.strokeStyle=ac;x.fillStyle=ac;
    ps.forEach(function(a){if(!RM){a.x+=a.vx;a.y+=a.vy;if(a.x<0||a.x>W)a.vx*=-1;if(a.y<0||a.y>H)a.vy*=-1}
      x.globalAlpha=.7;x.beginPath();x.arc(a.x,a.y,2,0,7);x.fill()});
    for(var i=0;i<ps.length;i++)for(var j=i+1;j<ps.length;j++){var d=Math.hypot(ps[i].x-ps[j].x,ps[i].y-ps[j].y);if(d<120){x.globalAlpha=(1-d/120)*.5;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(ps[i].x,ps[i].y);x.lineTo(ps[j].x,ps[j].y);x.stroke()}}
    if(!RM)requestAnimationFrame(f)}
  f();
})();
function setGauge(){var a=$("checks").querySelectorAll("input"),n=0;a.forEach(function(c){if(c.checked)n++});var q=a.length?n/a.length:0;$("gf").style.strokeDashoffset=220*(1-q);$("gtx").textContent=Math.round(q*100)+"%"}
$("checks").addEventListener("change",setGauge);
["tB","tS"].forEach(function(i){$(i).addEventListener("click",setGauge)});
document.querySelectorAll(".safe>div").forEach(function(d){d.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin",'<svg class="ck" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 40 40" fill="none" stroke="var(--up)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="16" pathLength="100"/><path d="M12 20.5l6 6 11-12" pathLength="100"/></svg>')});
(function(){
  var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");io.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.12});
  document.querySelectorAll("section").forEach(function(e){if(!RM)e.classList.add("rv");io.observe(e)});
  document.querySelectorAll(".sk,.vz,.safe>div,ol.steps").forEach(function(e){io.observe(e)});
})();
if(!RM&&window.matchMedia("(hover:hover)").matches){document.querySelectorAll(".sk,.asset,.why>div").forEach(function(e){
  e.addEventListener("mousemove",function(ev){var b=e.getBoundingClientRect(),px=(ev.clientX-b.left)/b.width-.5,py=(ev.clientY-b.top)/b.height-.5;e.style.transform="perspective(600px) rotateX("+(-py*8)+"deg) rotateY("+(px*8)+"deg)"});
  e.addEventListener("mouseleave",function(){e.style.transform=""})})}
(function(){var m=$("mqi");m.innerHTML+=m.innerHTML;var sp=$("sp");
  window.addEventListener("scroll",function(){var h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;sp.style.width=(h>0?window.scrollY/h*100:0)+"%"},{passive:true})})();

(function(){
  var T=["USDT","BTC","ETH","USDC","BNB","SOL","XRP","ADA","DOGE","TRX","DOT","LTC"],hm=$("hm");
  T.forEach(function(t){var d=document.createElement("div");d.className="ht";d.textContent=t;hm.appendChild(d)});
  function paint(){hm.childNodes.forEach(function(d){var t=d.textContent;
    d.style.background=(t==="USDT"||t==="USDC")?"rgba(39,117,202,.3)":(Math.random()>.45?"rgba(30,158,106,":"rgba(214,69,59,")+(.35+Math.random()*.55)+")"})}
  paint();if(!RM)setInterval(paint,1800);
})();
(function(){
  var A=[["USDT","#26A17B",60],["BTC","#F7931A",25],["ETH","#627EEA",15]],C=2*Math.PI*70,g=document.querySelector("#dn g"),cs=[],ins=[],ls=[];
  A.forEach(function(a,i){
    var c=mk("circle",{cx:100,cy:100,r:70,fill:"none",stroke:a[1],"stroke-width":26});g.appendChild(c);cs.push(c);
    var d=document.createElement("div");d.className="mr";d.style.setProperty("--c",a[1]);
    d.innerHTML='<label for="mx'+i+'"><span>'+a[0]+'</span><span id="ml'+i+'"></span></label><input id="mx'+i+'" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="'+a[2]+'">';
    $("mixc").appendChild(d);ins.push(d.querySelector("input"));ls.push(d.querySelector("span+span"));
    ins[i].oninput=draw;
  });
  var l=document.createElement("a");l.className="btn";l.href="#quote";l.textContent="Request a quote";l.style.cssText="text-decoration:none;text-align:center;max-width:260px";$("mixc").appendChild(l);
  function draw(){var v=ins.map(function(i){return +i.value}),t=v[0]+v[1]+v[2],acc=0;
    v.forEach(function(x,i){var share=t?x/t:0,len=share*C;cs[i].setAttribute("stroke-dasharray",len+" "+(C-len));cs[i].setAttribute("stroke-dashoffset",-acc);acc+=len;ls[i].textContent=Math.round(share*100)+"%"});
    $("dnt").textContent=t?"100%":"0%"}
  draw();
})();
(function(){
  var cv=document.createElement("canvas");cv.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");cv.style.cssText="position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:70";document.body.appendChild(cv);
  var x=cv.getContext("2d"),ps=[],f=0,done=false,col=["#26A17B","#F7931A","#627EEA","#E3A82B","#D6453B","#8B5CF6"];
  function step(){x.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);ps.forEach(function(p){p.vy+=.25;p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.r+=p.vr;x.save();x.translate(p.x,p.y);x.rotate(p.r);x.fillStyle=p.c;x.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,1-f/150);x.fillRect(-p.s/2,-p.s/4,p.s,p.s/2);x.restore()});
    if(++f<150)requestAnimationFrame(step);else x.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height)}
  function burst(){cv.width=innerWidth;cv.height=innerHeight;ps=[];f=0;for(var i=0;i<110;i++)ps.push({x:cv.width/2,y:cv.height/3,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*14,vy:-Math.random()*12,s:6+Math.random()*8,r:Math.random()*6,vr:(Math.random()-.5)*.4,c:col[i%6]});step()}
  $("checks").addEventListener("change",function(){var a=$("checks").querySelectorAll("input"),n=0;a.forEach(function(c){if(c.checked)n++});
    if(a.length&&n===a.length){if(!done&&!RM)burst();done=true}else done=false});
  ["tB","tS"].forEach(function(i){$(i).addEventListener("click",function(){done=false})});
})();
(function(){var fab=$("fab");new IntersectionObserver(function(e){fab.classList.toggle("hide",e[0].isIntersecting)}).observe($("quote"))})();
